items.t: What Could Biogen (BIIB) Gain From Its New Protein Degrader Research Deal?
items.sum: Biogen (NasdaqGS:BIIB) said it has entered a research collaboration with TRIMTECH Therapeutics to develop small molecule protein degraders for neurodegenerative diseases. The agreement focuses on discovering targeted degraders that aim to remove disease related proteins in conditions such as Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s.
